sub_graphs.title: EIP-7577: EIP Version Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of EIP versioning from draft through finalization

nodes.label: EIP in Draft Status
nodes.description: EIP is in draft status where versioning is optional, starting at 0.x.x

nodes.label: EIP Post-Draft Status
nodes.description: EIP has transitioned from draft, versioning is mandatory, version becomes 1.0.0

nodes.label: Transition EIP Status
nodes.description: Transition EIP from Draft to a post-draft status, triggering version to become 1.0.0

nodes.label: Version Number Updated
nodes.description: EIP has received a version increment after a specification change

external_entities.name: EIP Author
external_entities.description: Author responsible for version assignment and changelog maintenance

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7577: Version Increment Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for determining version increment scope

nodes.label: Pull Request Received
nodes.description: A pull request modifying an EIP has been submitted

nodes.label: Parse Commit Message Scope
nodes.description: Parse commit messages for scope markers: [Mm]ajor:, [Mm]inor:, or [Pp]atch:

nodes.label: Change Scope Determined
nodes.description: The scope of the change has been identified as major, minor, or patch

nodes.label: Validate Scope Indicator Present
nodes.description: Verify that commit message contains required scope indicator

nodes.label: Pull Request Blocked
nodes.description: PR merge is blocked due to missing scope indicator in commit message

nodes.label: Determine Maximum Severity
nodes.description: When multiple scope indicators exist, select the most severe (major > minor > patch)

nodes.label: Increment Version Number
nodes.description: Apply semantic versioning increment based on determined scope

nodes.label: Version Incremented
nodes.description: Version number has been incremented according to scope

external_entities.name: Pull Request Submitter
external_entities.description: Developer submitting changes to an EIP specification

external_entities.name: ethereum/EIPs Repository Tooling
external_entities.description: Automated tooling that processes and validates PR submissions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7577: Changelog Entry Generation
sub_graphs.description: Models the process of generating changelog entries for EIP updates

nodes.label: EIP Change Approved
nodes.description: A change to an EIP has been approved with proper scope designation

nodes.label: Generate Changelog Entry
nodes.description: Create structured changelog entry with version, date, PR number, and description

nodes.label: Update Version Header
nodes.description: Update the version field in EIP markdown metadata

nodes.label: Changelog Updated
nodes.description: New changelog entry has been added to the CHANGELOG section

nodes.label: EIP Fully Versioned
nodes.description: EIP has updated version header and changelog entry

ambiguities.text: PATCH: Any cosmetic change...without specification change
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'cosmetic change' means formatting, typos, grammar, or documentation improvements that do not alter the technical specification. This needs clarification from spec authors.

ambiguities.text: Responsibility assignment for scope determination when multiple authors contribute remains unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the PR submitter is responsible for scope designation, with maintainer review as validation.

ambiguities.text: Retroactive versioning guidance provides flexibility but creates historical inconsistency
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume retroactive versioning is best-effort and does not require precise historical reconstruction.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP authors understand and correctly apply semantic versioning principles
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect version increments could cause implementations to misinterpret compatibility requirements

implicit_assumptions.description: Commit message discipline will be maintained across all PR submissions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: PRs may be incorrectly blocked or approved without proper version tracking

implicit_assumptions.description: Reference test infrastructure will implement version-checking capabilities
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Test suites may run against incompatible EIP versions, producing invalid test results
